segments.text: ALmightie God whoſe prayſe this day, the young innocentes thy witneſſes hath confeſſed, and ſhewed foorth, not in ſpeakyng, but in dying: mortifye and kyll all vyces in vs: that in our conuerſacion, our lyfe may expreſſe thy fayth, whiche with our tongues we dooe confeſſe: through Ieſus Chriſt our Lorde.
